description: Hash-aware sibling of build_workflow_links (ChainGraph Standard v0.1 §8.1). Returns an ordered, executable DAG over the ChainGraph suite's verifiable tools, with explicit parent_hash wiring: which upstream execution_hash each step must cite in its chain block. Pass target_tool_id to build the chain that produces that node (walks consumes-edges back to roots), or tool_ids for an explicit ordered list, or neither to list available ChainGraph nodes. Agent loop: run a node, capture its execution_hash, pass it as the parent_hash for each downstream node, then verify with verify_execution_hash.

target_tool_id.description: A ChainGraph node tool_id (e.g. "art-15-agent-commerce-conformance"). Builds the chain that produces it.

tool_ids.description: Explicit ordered list of ChainGraph node tool_ids to wire.

name: build_chaingraph
title: Build an executable ChainGraph DAG
